description: This file contains a utility class `UtilFormatOut` providing various static methods for formatting numbers, currencies, percentages, quantities, dates, and strings, primarily for output purposes in JSPs and web apps within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilFormatOut
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for formatting numbers, dates, and strings for output, mainly for JSPs and web interfaces.

methods.name: safeToString
methods.description: Converts an object to a string safely, returning empty string if null.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a Double or BigDecimal number according to a specified format type, leveraging property templates.

methods.name: formatPrice
methods.description: Deprecated methods for formatting prices from Double or BigDecimal values.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a monetary value into a currency string based on locale, ISO code, and maximum fraction digits.

methods.name: formatDecimalNumber
methods.description: Formats a double into a number string based on a pattern and locale.

methods.name: formatSpelledOutAmount
methods.description: Converts a number into a spelled-out string based on locale using ICU4J RuleBasedNumberFormat.

methods.name: formatAmount
methods.description: Locale-aware formatting for amounts, replacing deprecated price methods.

methods.name: formatPercentage
methods.description: Formats a percentage Double or BigDecimal into a string.

methods.name: formatPercentageRate
methods.description: Converts a percentage decimal (e.g., 0.1) to a percentage string (e.g., 10%), with optional negation.

methods.name: formatQuantity
methods.description: Formats Quantity values from Long, Integer, Float, Double, or BigDecimal into strings.

methods.name: formatPaddedNumber
methods.description: Pads a long number with leading zeros to a specified total length.

methods.name: formatPaddingRemove
methods.description: Removes leading zeros from a string.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a SQL Timestamp or Date into a string with date/time formats, locale, and timezone considerations.

methods.name: formatDateTime
methods.description: Formats a Date into a date-time string considering custom format, locale, and timezone.

methods.name: makeString
methods.description: Converts an object to string, encoding byte[] data as base64 or returning empty string if null.

methods.name: checkNull
methods.description: Returns input string if not null, otherwise empty string or alternative string options.

methods.name: checkEmpty
methods.description: Returns the first non-empty string among inputs, or empty string.

methods.name: encodeQuery
methods.description: Encodes a URL query string by replacing spaces and percent signs.

methods.name: encodeQueryValue
methods.description: Encodes a URL query component by replacing reserved characters.

methods.name: replaceString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string (delegates to StringUtil).

methods.name: decodeQueryValue
methods.description: Decodes URL-encoded query value back to plain string.

methods.name: encodeXmlValue
methods.description: Encodes special characters in a string to XML entities.

methods.name: padString
methods.description: Pads a string to a specified length with a specified character, either at start or end.

methods.name: makeSqlSafe
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in SQL statements by doubling single quotes.

methods.name: formatPrintableCreditCard
methods.description: Masks all but last four digits of a credit card number with asterisks.
